full_prompt_en: A square monochrome drawing captures a tightly packed group of people in an interior during a charged exchange. Pale paper remains visible beneath gray washes, while energetic charcoal or black chalk lines build the darker clothing, hair, and recesses. Across the upper left, a framed architectural opening and layered cornice give the scene a shallow interior setting. Several background figures emerge from sketchy tones above and between the principal bodies, their faces turned in different directions. In the center, a light-haired man with an open white collar and dark jacket lifts his chin and looks toward the upper left, his expression alert. At the right foreground, a woman in a pale draped dress turns her head sharply upward and left; her sleeve and gathered waist make the brightest large shape in the drawing. At the left foreground, a dark-capped figure is seen mostly from behind, one arm bent across the scene and the other hand low near the central group. Another face appears at the far left edge, cropped closely by the frame. Hands reach and overlap in the lower center, adding a network of diagonal gestures between the main figures. The drawing uses rapid crosshatching, rubbed gray passages, and emphatic dark contours; faces are more carefully modeled, while the lower bodies become broad restless marks. Light seems to enter from the upper left or front, leaving the central faces, pale collar, and right-hand dress bright against blackened coats and the shaded doorway. There is no readable writing. The overall composition is crowded and turbulent, organized by interlocking heads, hands, and diagonal limbs in a textured range from paper white to deep charcoal.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形单色素描捕捉室内一群紧密挤在一起的人，正经历一场情绪紧张的交流。灰色洗染下仍能看到浅纸底，富有动势的炭笔或黑粉笔线条堆出较暗的衣服、头发和凹处。左上方，带框的建筑开口与层层檐线给场景一个浅空间的室内位置。数位后方人物从主体之间及上方草草铺开的色调中出现，面庞朝向各不相同。中央，一位浅发男子穿着敞开的白领和深色外套，抬起下巴望向左上，神情警觉。右前方，一名身穿浅色垂褶裙装的女子猛地向左上转头；她的袖子和束起的腰部成为素描里最亮的大片形状。左前方，一个戴深色帽的人大部分从背后可见，一条手臂弯过场景，另一只手低低地靠近中央人群。最左边缘还有一张脸，被画幅紧紧截住。双手在下方中央伸出并交错，在主要人物之间建立一组斜向姿态。素描运用迅速的交叉排线、擦开的灰面和有力的深色轮廓；脸部塑形较细，下部身体则化为宽放而不安定的笔痕。光仿佛从左上或前方进入，使中央面庞、浅色领口和右侧衣裙在漆黑外套及阴影门口前发亮。画中没有可读文字。整体构图拥挤而骚动，由交错的头、手和斜伸肢体组织起来，肌理从纸白一直延伸到深炭黑。
style_prompt_en: This monochrome drawing treatment uses charcoal-like pressure changes, fast crosshatching, and rubbed midtone smears to create animated volume. Paper white is kept in a few large open planes, while dense black-gray clusters anchor overlapping shapes and recesses. Contours vary from emphatic dark arcs to interrupted exploratory lines, so the surface retains visible process rather than a polished closed outline. Short diagonals and directional strokes carry movement across the frame; background forms are loosely suggested while a small focal area receives more precise tonal modeling. Light is conveyed by unmarked or lightly washed paper against heavily worked shadow, with no color to soften the value contrast. The composition feels compressed, energetic, and richly textured.
style_prompt_zh: 这种单色素描处理通过炭笔般的轻重变化、迅速的交叉排线和擦开的中灰色痕制造活跃体积。纸白留在少数大块开放平面，密集黑灰色群则固定相互遮挡的形状与凹处。轮廓从有力的深色弧线变化为断续的探索线，使表面保留可见的作画过程，而非封闭磨光的线。短斜线和有方向的笔触把运动传遍画面；背景形体只松散暗示，少量焦点区域才接受更准确的明暗塑形。光由未画或轻洗的纸面与反复经营的暗影相对表现，没有色彩来软化明度反差。构图压缩、有活力，而且肌理丰富。
theme_en: A crowded dramatic encounter drawn in charcoal
theme_zh: 炭笔绘成的拥挤戏剧性相遇
name: Reginald Marsh
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
